summary.text: Heather Holmes is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 24A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Duane Quam.
A researcher and former Byron Public School District board member, she also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Holmes said in a 2024 Ballotpedia survey that she grew up in northern Wisconsin on the shore of Lake Superior and earned a bachelor's degree in biology from the University of Wisconsin-Superior.

She said she pursued a career in scientific research, including work ranging from coral reef ecology to agriculture to medical research, and had worked as a technologist in a research lab for more than 17 years.
Holmes and her husband moved to Byron in 2006 and have a daughter, according to the survey.
Holmes held an at-large seat on the Byron Public School District board, according to Ballotpedia.
She lost the 2024 general election for District 24A to Quam.
Her 2024 survey named affordable healthcare, including mental health and rural emergency services, clean water and air, and action on climate change among her priorities.
